looks_bad_but_fine.why: Highest hotspot score in the repo, but it is a small (52 LOC) module with one cohesive responsibility (refund workflow: validate, post, notify gateway). Functions share the Refund/Entry data directly rather than reaching through object chains; not a god-class.
Gateway class has a single method and two attributes; it is a thin API-client facade by design, not a god-class.
Entry and Refund are plain dataclasses (DTOs), wide-by-design and not god-class candidates.

not_assessed: Repository is only 243 LOC across 16 files; no unit shows multiple disjoint responsibility clusters, high fan-in as a hub, or multi-hop chains to reach data, so the god-classes family does not apply to any file inspected.
